title: Echo and Signal
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Yara Almeida, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
